#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MAX_NODES = 10000;
const int SOURCE = 9998;
const int SINK = 9999;

struct Edge {
    int to, capacity, flow, cost;
};

vector<Edge> edges;
vector<int> adj[MAX_NODES];
long long totalCost, dist[MAX_NODES];
int numNodes, numEdges, numCommodities, unitCost, delayCost;
int prevNode[MAX_NODES], prevEdge[MAX_NODES];
bool inQueue[MAX_NODES];

void addDirectedEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cst) {
    adj[u].push_back(edges.size());
    edges.push_back({v, cap, 0, cst});
    adj[v].push_back(edges.size());
    edges.push_back({u, 0, 0, -cst});
}

bool findShortestPath() {
    fill(dist, dist + MAX_NODES, 1e18);
    fill(prevNode, prevNode + MAX_NODES, -1);
    fill(prevEdge, prevEdge + MAX_NODES, -1);
    fill(inQueue, inQueue + MAX_NODES, false);
    
    dist[SOURCE] = 0;
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(SOURCE);
    inQueue[SOURCE] = true;
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        inQueue[u] = false;
        
        for (int idx : adj[u]) {
            Edge& e = edges[idx];
            if (e.capacity - e.flow <= 0) continue;
            int v = e.to;
            long long newDist = dist[u] + e.cost;
            if (newDist < dist[v]) {
                dist[v] = newDist;
                prevNode[v] = u;
                prevEdge[v] = idx;
                if (!inQueue[v]) {
                    inQueue[v] = true;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (dist[SINK] == 1e18) return false;
    
    int cur = SINK;
    while (cur != SOURCE) {
        edges[prevEdge[cur]].flow++;
        edges[prevEdge[cur] ^ 1].flow--;
        cur = prevNode[cur];
    }
    
    totalCost += dist[SINK];
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> numNodes >> numEdges >> numCommodities >> unitCost >> delayCost;
    
    int u, v;
    for (int i = 0; i < numCommodities; i++) {
        cin >> u;
        u--;
        addDirectedEdge(SOURCE, u, 1, 0);
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= 101; i++) {
        addDirectedEdge((i-1)*numNodes, SINK, numCommodities, (i-1)*unitCost);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < numEdges; i++) {
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        for (int layer = 1; layer <= 100; layer++) {
            for (int commodity = 1; commodity <= numCommodities; commodity++) {
                int cost = delayCost * ((commodity-1)*2 + 1);
                addDirectedEdge(u + (layer-1)*numNodes, v + (layer-1)*numNodes + numNodes, 1, cost);
                addDirectedEdge(v + (layer-1)*numNodes, u + (layer-1)*numNodes + numNodes, 1, cost);
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int node = 0; node < numNodes; node++) {
        for (int layer = 1; layer <= 100; layer++) {
            addDirectedEdge(node + (layer-1)*numNodes, node + (layer-1)*numNodes + numNodes, numCommodities, 0);
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < numCommodities; i++) {
        findShortestPath();
    }
    
    cout << totalCost << '\n';
    return 0;
}
